meta.subject: Fix bug where UART receiver was waiting for extra stop bit

en.summary: This commit fixes an off-by-one error in the UART receive FSM: the receiver now shifts the 8th data bit and enters stop-bit handling immediately after 8 data samples instead of waiting one extra bit period.
why_it_counts: The patch changes UART peripheral RTL behavior directly.
The commit message describes a concrete receive corruption symptom and the diff matches that mechanism.
The fix corrects serial sampling and frame termination, which are DUT-visible behaviors.
evidence: The only modified DUT file is hardware/fpga/common/uart_receive.sv.
In STATE_READ_CHARACTER, do_shift is moved ahead of the terminal-count branch so the last sampled data bit is always captured.
The stop transition threshold changes from bit_count_ff == 8 to bit_count_ff == 7, which ends the data phase after exactly 8 bits.
The commit message states that the old behavior caused data corruption at low UART speeds.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is an end-of-frame timing error in a UART receiver. After sampling the final data bit of an 8N1 frame, the receiver should both capture that bit and transition to stop-bit checking. The broken behavior treats one extra bit time as if another data bit were still pending, so frame completion is delayed and the received byte can become misaligned.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: UART RX bit counter and data-to-stop transition
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A received character reaches its 8th data-bit sample point.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Make the receiver wait one extra bit period before entering stop-bit handling and/or skip shifting the terminal data bit on the final sample.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: restore off_by_one terminal count and gate final shift on the non-terminal branch
portability_notes: Apply this to the state machine that sequences start bit, data bits, and stop bits in any UART-like serial receiver.
If the implementation counts remaining bits instead of received bits, map the mutation to the final-data-bit termination comparison accordingly.
If shifting and state transition are separate controls, breaking either one can reproduce the same semantic bug.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the receive-state logic that fires when the bit-time counter reaches a sample point.
Change the terminal data-bit comparison so the FSM exits the data-bit phase one sample late.
Ensure the final sampled data bit is not unconditionally shifted into the receive register on the terminal sample.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix asserts do_shift before the terminal-count check and changes the terminal comparison from 8 to 7 so the 8th bit is captured before transitioning to STATE_STOP_BITS.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the sample_count_ff == 0 branch of STATE_READ_CHARACTER, move do_shift back into only the non-terminal path and restore the old bit_count_ff == 8 termination test.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Received UART bytes can be delayed by one bit period, lose the last data bit, or become misframed, producing byte corruption that is especially visible at low baud rates.
evidence_for_injection: The pre-fix code transitioned to stop handling only when bit_count_ff == 8 and only shifted in the else branch.
The fixed code captures every sampled bit, including the terminal one, before deciding whether to enter stop-bit processing.
The commit message ties the logic error to observed serial data corruption.
notes: This is a localized FSM mutation and does not require modifying tests or software.
The same portable mutation applies to UART receivers implemented in RTL, Chisel, or cycle-accurate models.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 UART 接收 FSM 中的一个 off-by-one 错误：接收器现在会在第 8 个数据位采样时完成移位，并在 8 个数据位后立即进入停止位处理，而不是再多等一个比特周期。
why_it_counts: 补丁直接修改了 UART 外设 RTL 行为。
提交信息描述了明确的接收损坏现象，而差分与该机制完全一致。
修复针对的是串口采样和帧结束控制，属于 DUT 可见行为。
evidence: 唯一被修改的 DUT 文件是 hardware/fpga/common/uart_receive.sv。
在 STATE_READ_CHARACTER 中，do_shift 被移到终止计数判断之前，因此最后一个采样到的数据位一定会被移入。
停止位切换阈值从 bit_count_ff == 8 改为 bit_count_ff == 7，使数据阶段在恰好 8 位后结束。
提交信息说明旧行为会在低 UART 速率下造成数据损坏。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 这是 UART 接收器中的帧结束时序错误。对于 8N1 帧，在采样到最后一个数据位之后，接收器应当同时捕获该位并进入停止位检查。错误实现把额外一个比特时间仍当作还有数据位未接收，从而推迟帧结束，并使接收字节产生错位。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: UART 接收位计数与数据位到停止位的状态切换
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 接收到一个字符的第 8 个数据位采样点时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让接收器在进入停止位处理前额外等待一个比特周期，和/或在最后一次采样时不移入终止数据位。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 恢复 off_by_one 终止计数，并把最后一次移位限制在非终止分支中
portability_notes: 将该变异应用到任何 UART 类串行接收器中负责 start bit、data bit、stop bit 切换的状态机。
如果实现按剩余位数而不是已接收位数计数，应把变异映射到等价的最后一个数据位终止比较条件。
如果移位控制和状态切换控制分离，只破坏其中任一项也能复现相同语义错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到接收状态中在位时间计数器到达采样点时执行的控制逻辑。
修改最后一个数据位的终止比较，使 FSM 在数据阶段晚一个采样点退出。
确保在终止采样点上，最后一个数据位不会被无条件移入接收寄存器。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: uart_receive 的 STATE_READ_CHARACTER 控制逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复通过在终止计数判断之前置位 do_shift，并将终止比较从 8 改为 7，使第 8 位在进入 STATE_STOP_BITS 前被正确捕获。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 STATE_READ_CHARACTER 的 sample_count_ff == 0 分支中，把 do_shift 移回仅非终止路径有效，并恢复旧的 bit_count_ff == 8 终止判断。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: UART 接收字节会多延迟一个比特周期、丢失最后一个数据位或发生帧错位，尤其在低波特率下更容易出现字节损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前代码只有在 bit_count_ff == 8 时才进入停止位处理，并且 do_shift 只在 else 分支中有效。
修复后代码在决定是否进入停止位处理之前，会先捕获每一个采样位，包括最后一个数据位。
提交信息明确将该逻辑错误与串口数据损坏联系起来。
notes: 这是局部 FSM 变异，不需要修改测试或软件。
相同的可移植变异适用于 RTL、Chisel 或周期精确模型中的 UART 接收器。
